source.quote: sad sve sablone izmeni, ne znam odakle si naucio da postavljas tako jeftin i ruzan font, pogotovo za svecanije prilike, menjaj font na svakoj da sajt zadrzi premium feeling, a ne random pozivnice od pre 20 godina sa paint msa. Na pocetku si perfektan bio, sad fusaris i forsiras jeftini izgled. Moras sve tacke ispunjavati da bih ti dao poen. Robi, fokusiraj se

requirements: Choose intentional refined occasion-appropriate type pairs; formal invitations need elegant calligraphy or classical display serifs, rather than casual marker-like handwriting.
Change typography on every design in the current batch, adjusting size, spacing, alignment and hierarchy to the actual font metrics.
Do not replace text layers with flattened text, alter backgrounds, restore retired designs, or overwrite personalized user drafts.
Keep names large and clear; preserve Serbian glyphs, long-name fitting, close age/event grouping and safe margins.
Review actual mobile and PNG/PDF outputs per design; technical validity alone does not establish aesthetic approval.
Every mandatory point remains required. Only the user may award points.
